description.value: Freshslice Pizza is a BC-based pizza chain known for its any-toppings-included slice model, with this location inside Valley Fair Mall in the Fraser Valley. Touring cyclists stopping here can grab a quick, filling slice or a full pie for takeout. The chain also offers delivery, catering, and a rewards app for frequent visitors.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 42m; rack at 60m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies this as a Freshslice Pizza fast food location (unit 640) at Valley Fair Mall in the Lower Mainland. The corporate website at freshslice.com confirms the brand is active and operating, and the OSM tag takeaway=yes is corroborated by the website's prominent 'Order for Delivery or Pickup' messaging. No location-specific amenity details (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi) are available from either the corporate website or OSM tags.
concerns: No full street address in OSM record — only addr:unit=640 and branch=Valley Fair Mall; a complete civic address would improve the listing.
Website is the corporate homepage only; no location-specific page found, so local phone number and address cannot be cross-verified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating fast food chain location inside Valley Fair Mall. A useful calorie stop for touring cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley.
